title: CatalogSmithProductCatalog
description: Schema for structured vendor product catalog extracted from video recordings (WhatsApp chat recordings, walkthroughs, or shelf displays).

vendor_name.description: Name of the vendor, business, or shop if identified from audio or visual cues.

vendor_phone.description: WhatsApp or phone number of the vendor if shown on screen (e.g., chat header, banner, watermark) or spoken.

currency_default.description: Primary currency detected (e.g., NGN, USD, GBP, EUR, KES, GHS).

products.description: List of distinct products identified in the video.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product (e.g. p1, p2, p3).

name.description: Concise, descriptive product title (e.g., 'Embroidered Kaftan Set', 'Leather Crossbody Bag').

price.description: Price details. MUST BE NULL if no price is shown or spoken. NEVER guess or invent a price.

amount.description: Numerical price value without commas or currency symbols (e.g. 15000).

currency.description: ISO currency code or standard abbreviation (e.g. NGN, USD, GBP, KES).

source.description: Where the price was detected: on_screen (chat message, text overlay), price_tag (physical tag or sticker), spoken (vendor narration), or none.

description.description: Short description covering material, color, size, available variants, or condition mentioned in audio or visuals.

category.description: Optional broad product category (e.g., Clothing, Bags, Footwear, Accessories, Electronics).

best_timestamp_sec.description: Timestamp in seconds (can be float, e.g. 14.5) where the item is most clearly visible, stationary, and unobstructed for frame capture.

confidence.description: Confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0 assessing visibility, identification accuracy, and pricing certainty.
